# Miami University

> Miami University is a top-ranked public research institution in Ohio known for exceptional undergraduate teaching, offering diverse academic programs across multiple campuses and online learning options.

Miami University operates campuses in Oxford, Hamilton, Middletown, and West Chester, Ohio, with a strong emphasis on the Miami Plan liberal education framework and study abroad opportunities. The university serves prospective students, current students, families, and job seekers across traditional and online learning formats.

## Key Topics

## Admissions and Enrollment

- [Admission and Aid](https://miamioh.edu/admission-aid/index.html): Central hub for admissions, financial aid, and enrollment information.
- [Majors, Minors, and Programs](https://miamioh.edu/admission-aid/majors-minors-programs/index.html): Searchable listing of majors, minors, and academic programs available.
- [Visit Miami's Campuses or Meet Us Online](https://miamioh.edu/visit-miami/index.html): Campus visit hub for Oxford, Middletown, Hamilton, and West Chester locations.
- [Visit Miami's Oxford Campus](https://miamioh.edu/visit-miami/oxford-campus/index.html): Oxford campus visit planning with virtual tours and open house information.
- [College Visit Programs](https://miamioh.edu/regionals/admission/schedule-visit/index.html): Virtual and in-person campus tours for Miami Regionals Hamilton and Middletown.

## Academic Programs and Learning

- [Explore Top-Ranked Academic Programs](https://miamioh.edu/academic-programs/index.html): Comprehensive academic program directory across colleges and schools.
- [The Miami Plan](https://miamioh.edu/academic-programs/academic-approach/index.html): Miami Plan curriculum framework and Four Pillars of academic approach.
- [Academic Advising](https://miamioh.edu/academic-programs/resources-services/academic-advising.html): Academic advising services and personalized course selection support.
- [Academic Calendars](https://miamioh.edu/academic-programs/academic-calendar/index.html): Academic calendars with semester dates, breaks, and exam schedules.
- [Top Online Degrees and Certificates in Ohio](https://miamioh.edu/online/index.html): Miami Online degree and certificate programs with flexible learning options.

## Student Life and Support

- [Life at Miami](https://miamioh.edu/life-at-miami/index.html): Student life overview including housing, dining, and campus activities.
- [Parent and Family Programs](https://miamioh.edu/life-at-miami/parent-family-programs/index.html): Parent engagement programs and family resources for student success.
- [Athletics and Recreation](https://miamioh.edu/athletics-recreation/index.html): NCAA Division I sports, intramurals, and campus recreation facilities.

## Global and Continuing Education

- [Education Abroad](https://miamioh.edu/global-initiatives/education-abroad/index.html): Study abroad programs including faculty-led and international internships.
- [Miami Luxembourg Application](https://miamioh.edu/global-initiatives/miami-in-luxembourg/apply.html): Application process for MUDEC study abroad program in Luxembourg.
- [Continuing Education](https://miamioh.edu/global-initiatives/continuing-education/index.html): Continuing education programs, workshops, and passport services.

## Employment

- [Jobs and Careers](https://miamioh.edu/human-resources/jobs-and-careers/index.html): Employment opportunities for faculty, staff, and student positions.
